headline: Looking for something to do this weekend? Here are the Top 5 local events for Oct. 3-4
teaser: From a free Bahamian festival in Stuart and a two-day makers market in Port St. Lucie to Oktoberfest, live music in Vero Beach and a Sunday car show in Fort Pierce, here are five Treasure Coast events worth checking out this weekend.
body:
The first weekend of October brings a mix of cultural celebrations, outdoor markets, live music and seasonal events across the Treasure Coast.

Treasure Coast Today reviewed this weekend's local event listings and picked five that stand out for their mix of broad appeal, local character and variety across Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties.

## 1. 30th Annual Bahamian Festival — Stuart

The 30th Annual Bahamian Festival takes over New Monrovia Park in Stuart on Saturday with a full day centered on Bahamian culture.

The free community celebration runs from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m. and is set to include Bahamian food vendors and live island music. The long Saturday schedule makes this one of the weekend's biggest all-day community events.

- **When:** Saturday, Oct. 3, 11 a.m.–7 p.m.
- **Where:** New Monrovia Park, 4453 SE Murray St., Stuart
- **Cost:** Free
- **Details:** [View the TCT event listing](https://treasurecoast.today/events/ef4993b718d3c0cf0e-30th-annual-bahamian-festival.html)

## 2. Florida Creatives Market — Port St. Lucie

If you want an event that works on either Saturday or Sunday, the Florida Creatives Market is the easiest pick on this list.

The free, two-day outdoor market at Clover Park is bringing together local makers, artists, small businesses and food vendors, with beverages and music also part of the event. It runs Saturday and Sunday, giving shoppers a full weekend to stop by.

- **When:** Saturday, Oct. 3 through Sunday, Oct. 4
- **Where:** Clover Park, 31 Piazza Drive, Port St. Lucie
- **Cost:** Free
- **Details:** [View the TCT event listing](https://treasurecoast.today/events/fd35510055b6aa2cf4-florida-creatives-market.html)

## 3. Oktoberfest — Port St. Lucie

Saturday evening brings Oktoberfest to the MIDFLORIDA Event Center, with an event lineup built around German music, dancing, Bavarian food and one particularly hard-to-ignore attraction: a wiener dog race.

The event runs from 5 to 9 p.m., making it a good evening option after one of the daytime festivals or markets elsewhere on the Treasure Coast.

- **When:** Saturday, Oct. 3, 5–9 p.m.
- **Where:** MIDFLORIDA Event Center, 9221 SE Event Center Place, Port St. Lucie
- **Cost:** No price is listed in the TCT event calendar
- **Details:** [View the TCT event listing](https://treasurecoast.today/events/7e0b247eefe5ca3f23-oktoberfest.html)

## 4. Jambush — Vero Beach

Indian River County's pick for the weekend is Jambush at Riverside Theatre in Vero Beach.

The Saturday evening performance brings together former members of The String Assassins with Florida musicians for a live show at Riverside Theatre. It is scheduled from 5:30 to 8:30 p.m.

- **When:** Saturday, Oct. 3, 5:30–8:30 p.m.
- **Where:** Riverside Theatre, 3250 Riverside Park Drive, Vero Beach
- **Cost:** No price is listed in the TCT event calendar
- **Details:** [View the TCT event listing](https://treasurecoast.today/events/57eea6ac237042fed4-jambush.html)

## 5. Cruzin' to Fall Car Show & '70s Dance Party — Fort Pierce

Sunday's standout combines a car show with an afternoon of 1970s rock at Summer Crush Vineyard & Winery in Fort Pierce.

The Cruzin' to Fall event runs from noon to 3 p.m. and pairs the car show with music from Collins & Company, including a salute to Journey, Phil Collins and Genesis. Admission is listed at $6.50.

- **When:** Sunday, Oct. 4, noon–3 p.m.
- **Where:** Summer Crush Vineyard & Winery, 4200 Johnston Road, Fort Pierce
- **Cost:** $6.50
- **Details:** [View the TCT event listing](https://treasurecoast.today/events/78f236497d6ebbdc0e-cruzin-to-fall-car-show-70-s-dance-party-with-special-salute-to-journe.html)

## More things to do

These are just five of the events happening around the Treasure Coast this weekend. You can browse more local festivals, markets, live music, family activities and community events on the [Treasure Coast Today Events Calendar](https://treasurecoast.today/events.html).

Event times, prices and availability can change, so check the individual event listing before heading out.
